title: Toast in the Kitchen  (Un brindis en la cocina)

segments.t: En el umbral de la cocina abierto al patio soleado, Tessa escucha desde su sillón lleno de cojines junto a Caleb y Owen mientras el vals de Evelyn flota sobre los adoquines. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Hear how effortlessly the second half flows from the first, Caleb?
You cannot even tell where thirty years ago ends and today begins.
And not one squeak on middle D. Graham earned two slices of lemon tart!
Raise your teacups, boys: to Room Nine and our saved courtyard!
To Chef Tessa, who ran an entire cafe kitchen from two pillows!
By Friday evening your ankle will be ready to greet every regular on the street.
Wait, look past the courtyard tree toward the open street gate, Caleb.
An older gentleman with a gray hat stopped right outside on the sidewalk.
He took his hat off when the piano reached the second page...
Wait a second: he is humming the exact melody along with Evelyn!
How could a stranger on the street know an unpublished waltz from a locked room?!
Call Hannah to the gate right now. Do not let him walk away!
Repasemos línea por línea este brindis interrumpido por una sorpresa en la acera.
Hear how effortlessly the second half flows from the first, Caleb?
'¿Oyes con qué fluidez tan natural pasa la segunda mitad desde la primera, Caleb?'
You cannot even tell where thirty years ago ends and today begins.
'Ni siquiera se nota dónde terminan esos treinta años atrás y dónde empieza hoy.'
And not one squeak on middle D. Graham earned two slices of lemon tart!
'Y ni un solo chirrido en el re central. ¡Graham se ha ganado dos porciones de tarta de limón!'
Raise your teacups, boys: to Room Nine and our saved courtyard!
'Alcen sus tazas de té, muchachos: ¡por la habitación nueve y por nuestro patio salvado!'
To Chef Tessa, who ran an entire cafe kitchen from two pillows!
'¡Por la chef Tessa, que dirigió toda una cocina de cafetería desde dos almohadas!'
By Friday evening your ankle will be ready to greet every regular on the street.
'Para el viernes por la tarde tu tobillo estará listo para saludar a cada cliente habitual de la calle.'
Wait, look past the courtyard tree toward the open street gate, Caleb.
'Espera, mira más allá del árbol del patio hacia el portón abierto de la calle, Caleb.'
An older gentleman with a gray hat stopped right outside on the sidewalk.
'Un caballero mayor con sombrero gris se ha detenido justo afuera en la acera.'
He took his hat off when the piano reached the second page...
'Se quitó el sombrero cuando el piano llegó a la segunda página...'
Wait a second: he is humming the exact melody along with Evelyn!
'Espera un segundo: ¡está tarareando la melodía exacta a la vez que Evelyn!'
How could a stranger on the street know an unpublished waltz from a locked room?!
'¿¡Cómo podría un desconocido en la calle saberse un vals inédito de una sala cerrada con llave!?'
Call Hannah to the gate right now. Do not let him walk away!
'Llama a Hannah al portón ahora mismo. ¡No dejes que se marche!'
Volvamos a escuchar completa esta escena desde la puerta de la cocina.
Hear how effortlessly the second half flows from the first, Caleb?
You cannot even tell where thirty years ago ends and today begins.
And not one squeak on middle D. Graham earned two slices of lemon tart!
Raise your teacups, boys: to Room Nine and our saved courtyard!
To Chef Tessa, who ran an entire cafe kitchen from two pillows!
By Friday evening your ankle will be ready to greet every regular on the street.
Wait, look past the courtyard tree toward the open street gate, Caleb.
An older gentleman with a gray hat stopped right outside on the sidewalk.
He took his hat off when the piano reached the second page...
Wait a second: he is humming the exact melody along with Evelyn!
How could a stranger on the street know an unpublished waltz from a locked room?!
Call Hannah to the gate right now. Do not let him walk away!
Fuera, frente al portón abierto, un transeúnte se sabe cada nota de un vals que llevaba treinta años guardado detrás de una estantería. Nos vemos en la próxima escena.
See you soon!
